assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: The widen drops its liveness read, so the live worker is reported as absent and the sentence becomes the proven-death one; the base arm records this case failing for exactly that reason.
The dead arm names a next attempt instead of the next resume or launch, or stops naming the fence field.
The session-walk arm presents the recorded pid or the stand-in's pid as the worker's, which the `pid \d` search and the stand-in exclusion both catch.
The unknown arm claims a launch or resume mounts the paths, or omits that liveness could not be read on this host.
The claim writer stops storing the added path under node.write_paths, so the literal supplied on the command line is absent from the reread pointer; this case is base-green by the plan's own design.

record_process_alive decides its boolean apart from the reading, so the monkeypatched arm no longer reaches it; the unknown arm's parametrisation is one of the declared negative control's four failures.
